Container.Name: mcp-github
Container.Overview: Official GitHub MCP server — exposes GitHub (Issues, PRs, Actions, Discussions, security, etc) as MCP tools over streamable-HTTP for AI agents. Runs the official binary's built-in `http` mode (default port 8082) instead of the default stdio mode via the PostArgs field below. Set ExtraParams below to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces (e.g. -p 100.101.102.103:8906:8082) — replace with your own Tailscale IP. IMPORTANT: in this native http mode, the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var below is NOT read per-request — every MCP client must send the PAT itself as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, or it gets an OAuth negotiation error instead of a permissions error.

Config.Name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Fine-grained PAT — Contents + Issues read/write on the repos you want it to manage, at minimum
